title: Oryx and Crake
author: Margaret Atwood
summary: Snowman may be the last human, living near a group of gentle engineered people. As he scavenges to survive, he remembers his friend Crake, a woman called Oryx and the world that led to the collapse.
readIf: you like literary science fiction about science and corporate greed gone wrong.
skipIf: you want a hopeful read, as it is bleak and critical of human behaviour.

pairings.reason: Another Atwood warning about a society reshaped by control, with a more political focus.
A starker, simpler story of survival after the end, with far less explanation.
A gentler, more hopeful look at the world after a pandemic ends it.
